formulas.K1_0: K = -sigma_n*sqrt(pi*L)  (Michel/weight-function, modulus- & time-independent); sigma_n=-H(t) => K1 = +sqrt(pi*L) => K1/sqrt(pi*L) = 1
formulas.K1_inf: same as K1_0:  K1_inf = sqrt(pi*L) => 1  (time independent)
formulas.p_faces_0: undrained p from zeta=0: p = -(nu_u-nu)*sigma_kk/[alpha(1-2nu)]; sigma_kk=-2 (sigma_xx=sigma_yy=-1 on the faces) => p_faces_0 = 2(nu_u-nu)/[alpha(1-2nu)]
formulas.K2_0: sigma_n=0 on faces => K2 = -sigma_n*sqrt(pi*L) = 0 (and p=1 is a measure-zero initial layer, no stress at t=0+)
formulas.K2_inf: at t->inf p is harmonic (p=1 on faces, 0 at infinity) => eigenstrain compatible => no stress => K2_inf = 0
formulas.V2_inf: harmonic p => no stress => no opening => V2_inf = 0
